title: Finite etale covers of closed subschemes of an affine normal scheme with separably closed function field (Stacks 09ZA)
statement: Let $X$ be an affine integral normal scheme [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] with separably closed function field [def-pc-separably-closed]. Let $Z\subseteq X$ be a closed subscheme [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $V\to Z$ be an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] with $V$ affine. Then $V$ is a finite disjoint union of open subschemes of $Z$. If $V\to Z$ is surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] and finite etale [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], then $V\to Z$ has a section.
